newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady, recovers early loss.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady, recovers early loss.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered from early losses in interbank trading on Tuesday as demand for the U.S. dollar from importers was largely offset by selling from the state-owned banks, dealers said.
The taka finished steady at 44.6490/6500 to the dollar against the previous close at 44.6480/6500.
The local unit was quoted weaker at 44.6480/6580 per dollar during early trade, but deals were done at around the 44.6500 level amid steady dollar supply from two large state-owned banks.
Call money traded slightly softer at 7.25 to 7.75 percent against the previous 7.5-8.0 percent.
